name: Cutpurse
summary: A crowd-working thief who lifts purses and slips away before the victim notices.
description: Cutpurses work festivals, docks, and market days, where a jostle and an apology cover a lot of sins. Most are bold for a week and dead or jailed within the year.

bonusActions.name: Quick Fingers
bonusActions.text: The cutpurse makes a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the Wisdom (Perception) of one creature within 5 feet. On a success, the cutpurse takes one object of 1 pound or less that the creature is carrying but not holding or wearing. The cutpurse then takes the {ref:glossary/disengage} action.
